pages.title: Ghost Hunt: Spirit Scanner
pages.creator: Prime Web Publish
pages.description: Search occupied rooms for hidden spirits in Ghost Hunt: Spirit Scanner. Scan suspicious people and objects until a reading exposes a ghost, then choose a weapon and destroy it. Clearing rooms earns rewards for improving your scanner, weapon, and ability to interact with objects. On a computer, move the pointer while holding the left mouse button to steer the view and choose targets. Touchscreen swipes handle the view and scanning on mobile devices.

pages.title: Tap Bead
pages.creator: Guangzhou Yomitoo Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Restore colorful bead patterns in Tap Bead. Remove beads that are in the wrong places, sort them by color, and put them back where the design requires them. A temporary buffer gives you somewhere to hold beads while adjusting the arrangement. Use the touch controls to work through the pattern and complete each level.

pages.title: Ninja Wars: Battle Simulator
pages.creator: Inspector Studios
pages.description: Arrange a ninja army before the fighting starts in Ninja Wars: Battle Simulator. Choose swordsmen, spearmen, and archers, then use the mouse to place the units into formation. Examine the opposing army before deciding how to organize your own forces. The game takes this preparation into three-dimensional battles across a series of levels, with victory depending on the army you build and position.

pages.title: Word Search Universe Easter
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Find concealed words in the letter grids of Word Search Universe Easter. The puzzles use an Easter and spring setting with colorful eggs and soft colors around the word-search activity. Use the mouse or touch controls to select the words you locate. Hints are available through rewarded ads when you need help finding another word.

pages.title: Bingo Halloween
pages.creator: Next Realm Games
pages.description: Mark called numbers and complete lines in Bingo Halloween. Click the matching numbers on your card as they are announced, working toward a horizontal, vertical, or diagonal bingo. Winning bingos unlocks Halloween candy-themed pictures, giving you a collection to uncover as you play. Different call-speed settings let you choose the pace at which the numbers arrive.

pages.title: Money Maker
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Build a virtual income-generating board in Money Maker. Drag pins into place to start earning, then combine two of the same tier to create a more valuable pin. Upgrading the Money Machine increases the value of your earnings as you develop the board. The idle progression centers on placing pins, choosing which ones to merge, and reinvesting in the machine.

pages.title: Survival in Area 51
pages.creator: Starodymov Games
pages.description:
Escape an underground disaster as Stas in Survival in Area 51. After an explosion brings zombies into the facility, fight through them and hostile mercenaries while searching for a way out. Follow the characters' dialogue, open doors, and use the blue buttons to work through the adventure's puzzles and locations toward a final battle.

Move with WASD or the arrows, look around with the mouse, and attack with left-click. Right-click aims, E interacts, and R reloads. The mouse wheel or number keys 1 and 2 change weapons; mobile controls use on-screen buttons and a joystick.

pages.title: Zombie Road: Shooter with Destruction
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Help Grandpa destroy his pursuers in Zombie Road: Shooter with Destruction. Fight armed zombies and mutants across locations ranging from deserts to sea battles. Buy guns and find attachments to assemble a weapon for the encounters ahead. On a computer, move the mouse to aim, left-click to shoot, and right-click to use the sights. Keys 1–4 switch weapons and R reloads. On a touchscreen, drag to aim and the weapon fires automatically.

pages.title: Vex Hyper Dash
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Jump between platforms and stay alive in Vex Hyper Dash. Mistimed jumps and contact with the course's dangers end the attempt, so the challenge is to extend the run and improve your high score. Use an arrow key, Space, or a mouse click to jump, and K or Shift to dash. Dash settings can be customized, including the on-screen button's placement on the left or right side.

pages.title: ASMR Beauty Superstar
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Give a clinic guest a treatment and makeover in ASMR Beauty Superstar. Work through the game's skin-care and foot-care activities for her acne-prone skin and rough feet, then customize her appearance. Hairstyle choices, makeup looks, and shoes let you put together the finished style. Use the mouse to handle the care tasks and styling selections.

pages.title: Tralala La La La italiano
pages.creator: IT-Hype
pages.description: Throw and combine animal figures in Tralala La La La italiano. Build up a collection of unusual animals as merging leads to new discoveries for your virtual zoo. Release a finger to throw on a phone, or press and release either mouse button on a computer. Helper items include a shake, hammer, bomb, and magic jar for use during the animal-combining challenge.

pages.title: Just Slap It!
pages.creator: Tejas Shrimali
pages.description: Take part in timing-based slap battles in Just Slap It! Click or tap the screen to slap, choosing the moment for your next hit as you compete against opponents. The game includes upgrades to unlock and a leaderboard for comparing results, adding progression to its short slap-fighting encounters.

pages.title: Vibrant Hearts Glamour vs Punk
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Dress three friends for Valentine's Day in Vibrant Hearts Glamour vs Punk. Explore romantic pink outfits with sequins and floral details, contrast them with black leather and gothic accessories, or blend both approaches into one look. Each friend has her own style preferences, but you choose the finished outfits. Click or tap to make selections, then save a completed look as a PNG image.

pages.title: Robby The Lava Tsunami
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Race toward the finish before a wave of lava catches you in Robby The Lava Tsunami. Jump through the parkour route and use special abilities to improve your chances against the other runners. Skins and purchasable hats offer ways to change the character's appearance. Move with WASD, aim the camera with the mouse, and press Space to jump. Number keys 1–5 activate abilities, while Tab or Escape pauses.

pages.title: Hide And Seek Horror Escape
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Choose a hiding or seeking role in Hide And Seek Horror Escape. Explore abandoned schools and haunted hospitals in an asymmetric horror setup, with hidden secrets and treasures to discover. Use mouse clicks or taps to play.

pages.title: City Builder
pages.creator: Dorfer Games OU
pages.description: Build a settlement from an undeveloped valley in City Builder. Gather resources such as wood and stone, clear resource zones, and work through house-building objectives as the town expands. Residents help with the development and provide equipment along the way. Move around the settlement with WASD or the arrow keys as you carry out the construction tasks.

pages.title: Throne vs Balloons
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Guide a bouncing, spiked ball through obstacles in Throne vs Balloons. Touch the screen to direct it toward the balloons, using rebounds from walls and other objects to reach targets. Pop all the balloons in a level to complete the challenge. Different obstacle arrangements make the path of the bouncing ball part of each puzzle.

pages.title: Jewel Block
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Fit jewel-shaped blocks onto a 10×10 board in Jewel Block. Drag pieces into position and complete entire rows or columns to remove them from the grid. Clearing several lines together earns bonus points. The attempt ends when the remaining spaces cannot hold another block, so each placement affects the room available for future pieces.

pages.title: Brave Squad
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Assemble a party of heroes and fight an ongoing series of enemies in Brave Squad. Tap the screen to attack, earning gold and other resources that strengthen the squad. Each hero brings different abilities to the team, and continued upgrades help you take on enemy waves and bosses. The game combines active clicking with an idle RPG structure as you develop the party.

pages.title: Choose My Summer Style
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Refresh the friends' vacation wardrobes in Choose My Summer Style. Use the left mouse button to select clothing and put together a summer look for each girl. The dress-up activity centers on helping the group decide what to wear for their holiday plans.

pages.title: Protect The Dog 3D
pages.creator: CHETRUSCA SOFTWORKS S.R.L
pages.description: Draw a barrier around a dog in Protect The Dog 3D. Hold the mouse button to mark a line, which becomes a wall designed to keep predatory animals away. To win, the animals must be unable to reach the dog; a gap that lets one through can cause a loss. The game contains 65 levels, with the sequence starting again after they are completed.

pages.title: Words Detective Bank Heist
pages.creator: Gameloft SE
pages.description: Find words to uncover an investigation in Words Detective Bank Heist. Pick letters to form the requested word, then use the completed answer to move the detective's case forward. The story unfolds through successive word challenges, linking the letter puzzles to the progress of the investigation.

pages.title: Pet Trainer Duel
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Guide cats through training courses in Pet Trainer Duel. The goal is to reduce each cat's weight during the run, with a weighing at the end determining the result. Work through levels in the one-player mode or compete with a friend in the two-player option. The controls use the left and right arrow keys and A/D for movement.

pages.title: Pixel Protect Your Planet
pages.creator: DarknesGamesStudio
pages.description: Circle a planet to intercept attackers in Pixel Protect Your Planet. The defender fires automatically, so steer around the planet to bring incoming androids into its line of fire. Use A and D on a keyboard, or touch the left or right side of the screen to rotate. Destroy invaders to build your score and keep them from reaching the planet.

pages.title: Solitaire Mahjong Farm
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Pair up farm-themed tiles in Solitaire Mahjong Farm. Select two matching tiles that are uncovered and have at least one free side to remove them from the layout. Clear every tile to finish the board, with faster completions earning a higher score. Further puzzles are shuffled randomly, giving you different arrangements to work through after a successful clear.

pages.title: Find the Way Home Maze Game
pages.creator: BestGameSpot
pages.description: Lead an alien through winding passages in Find the Way Home Maze Game. Find a route through the maze that brings the character home, working through 30 levels of corridor puzzles. Use the arrow keys to move on a computer, or swipe in the direction you want to travel on a touchscreen.

pages.title: Chess Fill
pages.creator: MathNook
pages.description: Paint a board by moving chess pieces across its squares in Chess Fill. Each piece follows its normal chess movement rules, turning the route through the board into the puzzle. Cover every square to complete the layout and continue through 70 levels. Swipe a piece with touch controls, or drag it while holding the left mouse button.

pages.title: Word Learner
pages.creator: kidsgamesplay
pages.description: Remember a briefly displayed word and rebuild it in Word Learner. After the word disappears, select letters from the alphabet shown on screen to spell it again. Choose a category such as animals, fruit, countries, birds, or flowers, or try the random option. Use the mouse to choose letters, or tap them on a touchscreen.

pages.title: Car Eats Car: Underwater Adventure
pages.creator: SMOKOKO LTD
pages.description:
Drive a monster car into chases and boss fights in Car Eats Car: Underwater Adventure. Overtake rival vehicles, battle the police, and work toward freeing imprisoned car friends. Create cars in the incubator and upgrade them as you progress.

Use W and S for acceleration and braking, with A and D to balance the vehicle; the arrow keys also handle driving and balance. Space uses bombs, while X activates turbo for an extra burst of speed during the chase.

pages.title: Exit the Maze
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Rotate the entire puzzle to guide a ball in Exit the Maze. Use the left and right arrow keys or touch controls to turn the three-dimensional maze, changing its orientation so the ball can travel toward the exit. Reaching the way out awards points and opens the next level. The challenge is to move the maze itself to create the ball's route.

pages.title: Impostor Warline 456 Survivors
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description: Stop an armed rebellion in Impostor Warline 456 Survivors. Shoot the participants who have turned against the games, collecting gold to improve your character's attributes while building your score. On a computer, use the mouse to shoot and use items, and move up or down with W/S or the arrow keys. Touch controls are also available.

pages.title: Atomic Puzzle 2
pages.creator: HyperCarrot
pages.description: Remove atoms in an order that clears the whole layout in Atomic Puzzle 2. Use the mouse to select combinations, considering how the remaining molecules will merge after each removal. A valid combination needs matching-colored atoms, with at most one atom left unpaired. The color of the atom you click does not matter. Plan the sequence so no atoms remain at the end.

pages.title: Rescue The Fancy Girl
pages.creator: Flash From The Past
pages.description: Search for clues and useful objects in Rescue The Fancy Girl. This point-and-click rescue puzzle asks you to inspect the scenes, gather items into an inventory, and work out where to use them. Solve the locks and other puzzles that stand in the way of helping the girl. Mouse or touchscreen controls handle the search and interactions.

pages.title: Squid Challenge Honeycomb
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description: Trace the marked shapes in Squid Challenge Honeycomb without crossing their painted lines. Select a character and work through the opening shapes before attempting the more demanding designs. A mistake ends the attempt and sends you back to the first shape, where you must choose another character and begin a new score. Careful tracing is the central challenge throughout the sequence.

pages.title: Uphill Rush 8
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Ride through water-slide courses in Uphill Rush 8. Guide your character along 20 levels using the arrow keys or tap controls, working through the twists of the waterslides. The game includes 32 vehicles and 67 outfits to play with and collect, giving you different ride and character combinations as you continue through the courses.

pages.title: Traffic Control
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Manage the cars in Traffic Control so their drivers reach the finish without hitting other vehicles or trams. Tap a car to speed it up and earn extra points, judging when it can pass through the traffic safely. A slowdown option helps when the road becomes difficult to manage. Watch the approaching vehicles before choosing which car to accelerate.

pages.title: Join Pusher 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Build a larger running group in Join Pusher 3D. Recruit more pushers as you move along the course, changing your route carefully to preserve the people already with you. Click to control the run and choose a path that keeps the group together while adding more recruits.

pages.title: Ninja Rabbit
pages.creator: Miniduck
pages.description: Help a rabbit rescue captured villagers in Ninja Rabbit. Click or touch to throw a shuriken toward a surface; when it sticks, the tether pulls the rabbit toward that point. Release to let go and aim another throw to continue across the stage. Collect carrots and reach cages while avoiding the enemies and hazards along the route. The movement challenge comes from choosing useful attachment points and releasing at the right moment.

pages.title: Parking Fury 3D: Night Thief
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Take on midnight driving jobs in Parking Fury 3D: Night Thief. Collect missions from the garage, deliver stolen cars, and follow the minimap arrows to the required destination. Police patrols can catch you, and too much damage can jeopardize the car's delivery. Successful work earns money toward new supercars. Drive with the arrow keys and press Ctrl to enter a vehicle.

pages.title: Rodeo Riders
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Tame animals for a zoo in Rodeo Riders. Take on missions and travel farther through each run to encounter rarer animals for visitors to see. Use the joystick controls to move as you search for more animals to bring into the zoo.

pages.title: Taxi Pickup
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Plan passenger journeys in Taxi Pickup. Guide a taxi to collect its customers, then take them to their destinations. Look over the route before starting and decide how to connect the pickups with the required drop-offs.

pages.title: Relics of the Fallen
pages.creator: Crescentyr
pages.description: Choose a hero and explore a dungeon through cards in Relics of the Fallen. This turn-based crawler combines roguelike runs with battles against monsters, useful items, and relics to collect. Plan each move to stay alive and prepare for boss encounters. Discovering more cards introduces additional mechanics to consider as you work through later attempts.

pages.title: Galaxy Attack Virus Shooter
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Pilot a combat aircraft against incoming viruses in Galaxy Attack Virus Shooter. Drag to move the craft, steering away from the viruses while attacking them. Developing your weapon helps handle the large numbers of targets in this retro-style flight shooter.

pages.title: Fill The Balls
pages.creator: Hitgames.org
pages.description: Arrange a route for falling balls in Fill The Balls. Click or tap to adjust the handles and arms, positioning them to direct the balls into the bowl. Once the setup is ready, press the Ready button to release the balls and see how the arrangement works. More than 100 levels provide different layouts to solve with these adjustable guides.

pages.title: Burger Trucks Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Assemble pictures of burger food trucks in Burger Trucks Jigsaw. Choose from 12 images and select Easy, Medium, or Hard before putting the pieces into their correct positions. Use the mouse to restore the complete truck picture, matching details across the separate fragments.

pages.title: Monster Truck Stunt Adventure
pages.creator: gameworld
pages.description: Drive a large monster truck through stunt courses in Monster Truck Stunt Adventure. Use WASD to control the vehicle and follow the route through checkpoints toward the stage's finish point. The game uses separate levels with further driving courses to complete.

pages.title: Offroad Animal Truck Transport Simulator 2020
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Deliver animals to the zoo in Offroad Animal Truck Transport Simulator 2020. Load the transport truck's cage and carry farm animals and wildlife to the unloading destination. The cargo includes animals such as cows, horses, zebras, and elephants. Use WASD for both driving and walking as you handle the transportation duties.

pages.title: Baby Animal Cross Word
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Fill a crossword with the names of young animals in Baby Animal Cross Word. Read the parent-animal clues and enter the corresponding baby names, such as puppy or kitten, into the grid. The puzzle contains 17 clues and a Check Answers option. Use the mouse or keyboard to work through the words and check your completed entries.

pages.title: Sushi Sensei
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Cut through different kinds of sushi for points in Sushi Sensei. An interactive tutorial introduces the slicing activity, and successful cuts can earn combo points as well as the regular score. The targets include rolls and sushi made with ingredients such as salmon, tuna, shrimp, and seaweed, all presented in a sushi-bar setting with visible blade effects.

pages.title: Pixel Car vs Cops 2020
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Escape a police pursuit in Pixel Car vs Cops 2020. Steer with the arrow keys and try to make the chasing police cars crash. Causing those collisions earns points while you continue driving away from the pursuit.

pages.title: Offroad Trucks Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Reassemble twelve truck pictures in Offroad Trucks Jigsaw. Grab the scattered pieces with the mouse, or use a finger on a touchscreen, and put them together to restore each off-road vehicle image. Complete all twelve pictures to finish the game's collection of truck puzzles.

pages.title: Five Nights At Old Toy Factory 2020
pages.creator: danygames.com
pages.description: Explore a factory after dark as its night guard in Five Nights At Old Toy Factory 2020. Strange events interrupt the shift, and your task is to survive five nights. Move with WASD or the arrows and look around with the mouse. Left-click attacks, right-click blocks, and F interacts with objects. Shift lets you run, Ctrl crouches, and Space jumps as you investigate the factory.

pages.title: Granny House
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Find a way out of an abandoned asylum in Granny House. Granny is nearby, so move quietly and avoid making noise that could expose your presence. Escaping requires staying clear of her as you explore. WASD moves your character, Space jumps, and Left Shift runs.

pages.title: Onnect Game
pages.creator: fugames
pages.description: Restore scrambled pictures by sliding tiles in Onnect Game. Click a fragment beside the empty square to move it into that space, then continue rearranging the pieces until the whole image is correct. Picture themes include pets, cars, cakes, and scenery. Each move changes the blank square's position, so consider how it will let you reach the next piece.

pages.title: Ellie Tattoo Procedure
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Choose two designs for Ellie's makeover in Ellie Tattoo Procedure. Pick a tattoo for her arm and another for her back, then follow the game's tattoo-shop activities to apply the selected artwork. Tap to make choices and carry out the in-game steps as you complete the tattoos for her rock-inspired look.

pages.title: Archer.ro
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Build a settlement and defend it with a bow in Archer.ro. Place buildings and use upgrades while your hero archer fights continuing waves of zombies. Move the hero with WASD, aim with the cursor, and left-click to shoot at the attackers threatening your developing empire.

pages.title: Destroyed City Drive
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Cross a ruined city along an uneven route in Destroyed City Drive. Your objective is to get the vehicle to its destination through the damaged setting. Use WASD or the arrow keys to handle the driving along the broken path.

pages.title: Impossible Parking Army Tank
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Drive a tank along elevated zigzag courses in Impossible Parking Army Tank. Negotiate the air ramps and obstacles, then guide the vehicle into its parking position. WASD and the arrow keys provide the driving controls for both the route and the final parking task.

pages.title: Neoblox
pages.creator: NanoTribe GmbH
pages.description:
Place shaped blocks to complete horizontal rows in Neoblox. Drag each piece onto the board, filling gaps to score points. One completed row earns one point; completing two together gives four, and three gives nine.

The top two rows have a special effect: placing a block there slides the board downward. If an unfilled space moves off the bottom of the screen, the game ends. Plan around the remaining gaps before using those upper rows and work toward improving your high score.

pages.title: Mermaids Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Put mermaid pictures back together in Mermaids Slide. Choose from three images and three play modes, then use the mouse to rearrange the picture sections into the completed scene.

pages.title: Dino Run
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Keep a dinosaur clear of birds, cacti, and pits in Dino Run. Jump over hazards and slide when the route calls for it, trying to carry the run far enough to improve your score. The Up and Down keys control jumping and sliding, with corresponding buttons available on screen. Watch the obstacles ahead to choose the action that gets the dinosaur through.

pages.title: Horse Racing Derby Quest
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Race as a young jockey and develop your stable in Horse Racing Derby Quest. Compete against other riders across 40 tracks and derbies, then care for your horses and improve their performance between races. The stable also lets you develop the jockey. During a race, time presses of the on-screen whip button carefully: overusing it can make the horse stop.

pages.title: Porsche Taycan Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Restore car photographs in Porsche Taycan Slide. Pick one of three Porsche Taycan images and choose among three puzzle modes. Use the mouse to rearrange the sliding sections until they form the complete picture.

pages.title: Zigzag Ball
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Follow a narrow, turning road in Zigzag Ball. Click the screen or press Space to change the ball's direction, timing each turn to keep it on the path. Gems add extra points to your score as you collect them. Falling from an edge ends the run, making the next direction change as important as the next pickup.

pages.title: Halloween Blocks Collaspse Delux
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Join matching Halloween blocks into chains in Halloween Blocks Collaspse Delux. Use the mouse to connect at least two similar blocks and collapse the group. Bigger connections earn more points and can produce power-ups; clearing seven or more blocks creates a bomb. Look through the arrangement for a longer connection when you want to work toward that bonus.

pages.title: Bicycle Stunts 3D
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Ride a bicycle along elevated stunt tracks in Bicycle Stunts 3D. The courses place the cycling action high above the ground, with dangerous sections to negotiate as you attempt stunts. Control the bike with the arrow keys, guiding the rider through the route and managing the approach to each part of the track.

pages.title: Jelly Crush Match3
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Swap neighboring jelly pieces to make matching lines in Jelly Crush Match3. Drag with the mouse to bring at least three of one color together, clearing them and adding to your score as new pieces fill the gaps. Matches also replenish the time meter. Keep finding combinations before it empties, then compare your result with the recorded best score.

pages.title: Trucks Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Choose a truck picture and rebuild it piece by piece in Trucks Puzzle. Six images are available, and each can be played with 16, 36, 64, or 100 jigsaw pieces. Mouse or tap controls let you arrange the sections into the complete vehicle picture.

pages.title: Bear Adventure
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Collect fish while keeping a bear away from its shadow in Bear Adventure. Use the arrow keys or touch controls to move around and gather as many fish as possible for a higher score. Contact with the shadow ends the attempt, so your route must account for both the food you want and the danger you need to avoid.

pages.title: French Cars Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: French Cars Jigsaw turns 12 vehicle images into puzzles with three difficulty settings. Choose easy for a 25-piece arrangement, medium for 49 pieces, or hard for 100. Use the mouse or touchscreen to put the sections together and reveal the finished car picture. You can choose the piece count separately for each image in the collection.

pages.title: CarFight.io
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Ram rival vehicles off a rooftop in CarFight.io. Drag the mouse to control your car and collide with opponents, trying to become the last vehicle left on the roof. Destroying more cars increases your vehicle's size and builds the score. Rivals can knock you over the edge too, so watch your position while lining up the next impact.

pages.title: Alien Town
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Defend the town as special agent Briggs in Alien Town. Start with a pistol and earn coins for eliminating the invading aliens, then purchase weapons including a machine gun, shotgun, rifle, and alien gun. Exploding barrels can set nearby aliens on fire, giving you another way to attack. The isometric shooter includes Survival, Hard Point, and Nuke modes, plus statistics to review after each day.

pages.title: Dream Head Soccer
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Put the ball into the opposing net in Dream Head Soccer. Choose your team and character, then face a computer-controlled rival in a timed football match. Use the arrow keys to control your player, working to score while defending your own goal. The match keeps track of both sides' goals as the remaining time counts down.

pages.title: Willow Pond Fishing
pages.creator: Playcombo
pages.description: Choose a lakeside spot and try to land a larger catch in Willow Pond Fishing. Select a fishing location from the navigation menu, pick where to cast the bait, and use the reel to bring fish in. Catch both small and large fish while working toward improvements such as new rods, lures, and fishing places.

pages.title: Age of Pixel
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Build an economy and raise an army in Age of Pixel. Start with structures that generate resources, then create battle units to develop your military force.

pages.title: House Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Paint house illustrations in House Coloring Book. Choose a picture, select a color for the brush, and fill the drawing with your own combination of shades. Work on the different parts of the house until you have the appearance you want.

pages.title: New Year Shopping
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Help Princess Emma buy party supplies in New Year Shopping. She is preparing a New Year celebration at home and needs groceries from a nearby store. Use the mouse to make the shopping selections and help her gather the things needed for the preparations.

pages.title: Octum
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Protect a central core from approaching balls in Octum. Touch the screen to make the surrounding ring vibrate and use it to shield the core from incoming hits. Watch the balls as they close in and activate the ring to keep them away from the center.

pages.title: Ball Helix 2
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Rotate the helix to connect with matching colors in Ball Helix 2. Swipe to turn it, bringing the correct colored blocks into the ball's path. Keep checking the ball's color against the sections ahead as you work through the levels.

pages.title: Mr Gun
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Make your shot count in Mr Gun. Aim at an opponent without a scope and try to land the hit with the chance you are given. Missing leaves you at risk from the enemy's reply, turning the exchange into a test of precision.

pages.title: Bamboo Panda
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Chop a bamboo stalk from either side in Bamboo Panda. Use the left and right arrow keys or the screen controls to choose which side the hungry panda attacks from. Clear sections to build your score, avoiding the armed pandas hiding along the stalk. Watch the next section before striking so you can move to the safer side.

pages.title: Kendama Battle
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Prepare a princess for a toy competition in Kendama Battle. Design three different personalized kendamas, then help her practice before entering her first contest. The required custom designs make decorating the toys part of getting ready for the event.

pages.title: Anna Social Media Butterfly
pages.creator: MyCuteGames
pages.description: Dress Anna for outings and social-media moments in Anna Social Media Butterfly. Browse clothing and hairstyle choices, putting together a look before she joins friends and family. Her completed outfits appear in scenes presented through the game's phone and social-network theme.

pages.title: My Talking Pig Mimy
pages.creator: Princess Girls
pages.description: Look after an animated pig in My Talking Pig Mimy. Choose activity buttons to give the pet a meal, play with a ball, or send her to rest. Other selections lead to bathroom animations and a stage activity with colored buttons that earn points. Tap the pig and on-screen objects to trigger reactions and sounds as you explore the different activities.

pages.title: Kids Donuts Challenge
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Prepare donuts for a children's cooking contest in Kids Donuts Challenge. Help the contestants cook their entries, then decorate the donuts before the judges give their results. The challenge combines making the treats with deciding how they should look for presentation.

pages.title: Bob the Robber 3
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Help Bob take on an international conspiracy in Bob the Robber 3. Hide, search, and choose the right moment to attack guards as he works with the good guys. Special gadgets and tools, including night-vision equipment, support his efforts.

pages.title: Blondie Wedding Prep
pages.creator: DariaGames.com
pages.description: Prepare a bride's complete look in Blondie Wedding Prep. Begin with makeup, choosing colors for the wedding before moving on to her outfit. Style her hair and select a veil to go with the clothing, then finish with a manicure and painted nails. The makeover takes you through cosmetics, bridal styling, and nail decoration for Blondie's wedding day.

pages.title: Doll Creator Spring Trends.
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Create and dress dolls in Doll Creator Spring Trends. After making a doll, choose outfits for three everyday settings: a park walk, a trip through the city, and a school day. Match the clothing choices to the occasion as you work through the different looks.
